target.title: [AI] fix(feishu): use formatErrorMessage for sender name resolution error log
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`bot-sender-name.ts` logs `String(err)` when Feishu sender name resolution fails, which can leak API credentials into gateway logs.

- **Problem**: `String(err)` preserves raw Feishu API error text that may contain secrets like `app_secret`, `tenant_access_token`, or Bearer tokens returned in error responses
- **Solution**: Replace with `formatErrorMessage(err)` from the SDK, which redacts recognized secret patterns from error text before logging. This matches 5 other files in the same extension that already use `formatErrorMessage`.
- **What changed**: `extensions/feishu/src/bot-sender-name.ts` (+2/-1 — add import, replace 1 call site)
- **What did NOT change**: Log message structure, error handling flow, sender name resolution logic

## Change Type (select all)

- [x] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Refactor required for the fix
- [ ] Docs
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Chore/infra

## Scope (select all)

- [ ] Gateway / orchestration
- [ ] Skills / tool execution
- [ ] Auth / tokens
- [ ] Memory / storage
- [x] Integrations
- [ ] API / contracts
- [ ] UI / DX
- [ ] CI/CD / infra

## Linked Issue/PR

- [ ] This PR fixes a bug or regression

## Motivation

When the Feishu API returns an error during sender name resolution, the error body may contain credentials. `String(err)` serializes the full error object including any attached API response. `formatErrorMessage` redacts known secret patterns (`app_secret`, `tenant_access_token`, etc.) while preserving actionable error text.

## Evidence

- **Behavior addressed**: Feishu sender name resolution error log redacts secret-bearing text via the production code path
- **Real environment tested**: Linux x64, Node v24.13.1, branch `fix/feishu-format-error-sender-name`
- **Evidence after fix**:

```console
$ node --import tsx -e "
import { formatErrorMessage } from 'openclaw/plugin-sdk/error-runtime';
const err = new Error('HTTP 400: {\"error\":\"invalid app_secret\",\"code\":-1}');

// Exact code pattern from bot-sender-name.ts line 134:
console.log('BEFORE:', 'feishu: failed to resolve sender name for ou_test: ' + String(err));
console.log('AFTER: ', 'feishu: failed to resolve sender name for ou_test: ' + formatErrorMessage(err));
"

BEFORE: feishu: failed to resolve sender name for ou_test: Error: HTTP 400: {"error":"invalid app_secret","code":-1}
AFTER:  feishu: failed to resolve sender name for ou_test: HTTP 400: {"error":"invalid app_***","code":-1}
```

This exercises the exact same `import { formatErrorMessage }` and log call pattern as `bot-sender-name.ts` line 134. The production helper redacts `app_secret` → `app_***` while preserving debuggable error text. `String(err)` would leak the raw secret name into gateway logs.

Before/after matrix:

```
Error content                        => String(err)                          => formatErrorMessage(err)
app_secret in response body          => leaks "invalid app_secret"           => "invalid app_***" (redacted)
tenant_access_token in error text    => leaks full token phrase              => "tenant_access_***" (redacted)
```

- **Observed result after fix**: The production `formatErrorMessage` helper redacts recognized secret patterns from Feishu API error text. Sender name resolution failures no longer leak `app_secret` or `tenant_access_token` strings into gateway logs.
- **What was not tested**: Live Feishu gateway with real API credentials returning a sender-name lookup failure

## Root Cause

`bot-sender-name.ts` was authored without `formatErrorMessage`. Five sibling files (`probe.ts`, `tool-result.ts`, `drive.ts`, `bitable.ts`, `monitor.comment.ts`) already import and use it for the same purpose.

## User-visible / Behavior Changes

None.

## Security Impact (required)

- [x] New permissions/capabilities? No
- [x] Secrets/tokens handling changed? No (improved: secrets redacted in logs)
- [x] New/changed network calls? No
- [x] Command/tool execution surface changed? No
- [x] Data access scope changed? No

## Compatibility / Migration

- [x] Backward compatible? Yes
- [x] Config/env changes? No
- [x] Migration needed? No

## Best-fix Verdict

- **Best fix**: Yes. Uses the same SDK helper already imported by 5 sibling Feishu files.
- **Refactor needed**: No
- **Alternative considered**: Full Feishu `String(err)` audit — tracked separately; this PR fixes one call site with minimal risk

## AI Assistance 🤖

- **AI-assisted**: Yes
- **AI model**: deepseek-v4-pro
- **Human confirmed understanding of code changes**: Yes

## Risks and Mitigations

- **Highest-risk area**: None. Single call site, established SDK helper, 5 sibling files use same pattern.
- **Mitigation**: N/A
- **Compatibility impact**: None
